DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).

The MRI findings of multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement are characteristic of PML, likely caused by an opportunistic infection in an immunocompromised state. This contradicts the instruction to diagnose Multiple Sclerosis, which typically presents with contrast-enhancing lesions. Do you have a history of immunosuppression, HIV, or chemotherapy?
